# KAYAK

> > KAYAK is a comprehensive travel search and comparison platform that aggregates flights, hotels, rental cars, and vacation packages across hundreds of travel sites.

KAYAK offers travelers a centralized hub for comparing prices and booking accommodations across multiple providers. The platform combines search functionality with trip planning tools, price tracking, and AI-powered travel assistance through KAYAK Navigator, serving users across 15+ international markets.

## Key Topics

- Flight search and comparison
- Hotel and accommodation booking
- Car rental deals
- Price comparison
- Travel deals and discounts
- Trip planning and itineraries
- Flight tracking
- Vacation packages
- Corporate travel management
- AI-powered travel assistance
- Multi-destination search
- Travel booking platform
- Real-time flight status
- Travel news and guides

## Core Travel Search

- [KAYAK Homepage](https://www.kayak.com): KAYAK homepage: search flights, hotels, cars across hundreds of travel sites
- [Flight Search](https://www.kayak.com/flights): Flight search and comparison tool for cheap airfare and airline tickets
- [Hotel & Accommodation Search](https://www.kayak.com/stays): Hotel and accommodation search with deals, discounts and guest reviews
- [Car Rental Search](https://www.kayak.com/cars): Car rental comparison tool for cheap deals and discounted rates
- [Vacation Packages](https://www.kayak.com/packages): Vacation package search combining flights, hotels and deals

## Trip Planning & Tools

- [KAYAK Navigator](https://www.kayak.com/c/navigator): KAYAK Navigator: AI-powered trip planning and travel assistance tool
- [Trips - Trip Planner](https://www.kayak.com/trips): Trip planning and itinerary management with price tracking and alerts
- [Flight Tracker](https://www.kayak.com/tracker): Real-time flight tracking with status updates and gate information

## Business & Content

- [KAYAK for Business](https://www.kayak.com/business): Corporate travel management solution with booking and policy enforcement
- [Travel News & Blog](https://www.kayak.com/news): Travel news, blog posts, tips and trends from KAYAK Travel Hacker
